svg.title: A sector ball lies in energy slab (n + 1)R; apply TR11 and a sufficiently large product weight. Cauchy–Schwarz and R (1 + |k|)−4dλ < ∞show that |q| Q i(1 + |ki|)−d−2 is integrable, controlling all ensuing integrals by fixed Schwartz seminorms. Slot dilation preserves the bound by 1 + 2|k| ≤ 2(1 + |k|). With bg−(p) = bg+(−p), sector extraction from TR22 gives Z q Y j |kj|bgj,−((kj)+)dλn = Z ̄q Y j |kj|bgj,+((kj)+)dλn. (TR32)
